title: Design-system registry (capability design-system-styling)
description: Single index for the --style output layer. SPLIT registry: owned/canonical systems live in Tier-1 00-core/design-system/<name>/; downloaded third-party live in the gitignored runtime/design-systems/<name>/ cache. registration != materialization (AD-2): a system may be registered metadata-first and materialized lazily on first use. Structural shape only; file-existence + owned-not-in-runtime are enforced by scripts/cross-tier/validate-design-systems.cjs.

name.description: Unique slug; the value passed to --style=<name>.

origin.description: owned = Tier-1 identity (00-core); downloaded = key-free getdesign cache; built-from-repo = hydrated from a public repo via the build verb (no API key).

source_ref.description: repo path/URL or library id the system was built/downloaded from.

path.description: repo-relative path to the DESIGN.md. owned → 00-core/design-system/<name>/DESIGN.md; downloaded → runtime/design-systems/<name>/DESIGN.md.

status.description: pending = owned, registered, not yet committed (sprint in-between). installed = owned, file present. cached = downloaded, file present. not_cached = registered, lazily materialized on first use. cache-pending-key = designmd entry awaiting an optional operator key. vendored = promoted cache→Tier-1. File-existence is required only for installed|cached|vendored.

license.description: SPDX-ish license of a third-party system (R2 license gate). null for owned. Non-redistributable licenses are flagged before caching.

last_synced.description: ISO date of last download/build, or null if never materialized.
